versions.changelog: SkillSpector v1.1: explicit triggers, security warnings, ingest --i-authorize consent gate

LYGO Prompt Implant System (LPIS) v1.0.0 initial release.

- Ingests external system prompts from user-supplied files or URLs.
- Extracts cognitive prompt patterns (plan, delegate, verify, safety).
- Generates sovereign prompt variants for Grok, Ollama, and local agent environments.
- Provides ledger implants and advisory implant mode (manual integration).
- Integrates with Biophase7 Fable/agent-prompt architectures and protocol stack.
- CLI tools for ingest, analyze, generate, implant, anchor, and egg operations included.
